payload.text: WP13's parity record, its five sync rows (AC-00.5). The email rows are the same (hv's second run; WP13's body, 728465f). The sync rows need Contacts access, which hv's terminal app cannot be granted (it declares no NSContactsUsageDescription; iTerm.app does). Released when hv has run parity/hv-next.zsh contacts from iTerm and pasted its lines; then cc classifies the rows into WP13's body and deletes the outputs. If Contacts reads authorized plainly but not inside sandbox-exec, the rows also wait for vc's ruling on their write guard.
